answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in whisper, checked in glacier, and karst reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3756 identities would post 4608 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
